title: Groom Adjusting Bride Veil, Wedding Couple - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot capturing an intimate pre-ceremony or post-ceremony moment between a bride and groom, circa 1960. The groom wears a classic white dinner jacket with a black bow tie and pocket square, reaching to adjust the bride's veil and curled hair. The smiling bride is seated in an intricate lace long-sleeve gown with a beaded or fabric headpiece. In the background, patterned vintage wallpaper and sheer curtains frame the domestic scene.
